items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: Well, the first time I heard him, it was in the Middle East before he left. And he used to live next to my Uncle Jim McCann's house.

ctx.x: What did you hear of Rene Hall play?

Well, the first time I heard him, it was in the Middle East before he left. And he used to live next to my Uncle Jim McCann's house. And then when I went to Tulsa, he was, like I told you, in three years of talk, he was arranging for the band, old man, Tulsa, Planet Fields. What instrument did he play? He was a guitarist. That's all. I imagine you could play saxophone. Well, I imagine you play most of the strings. It's no problem to play strings if you play one.
A lot of guys double on bad gear in guitar. That's right.
